root_cause: orders.amount now contains non-numeric text, so the seed loads it as VARCHAR which violates the INTEGER contract on fct_orders.amount.
evidence: contract_enforcement error: column amount is VARCHAR but the contract requires INTEGER
stg_orders.sql passes amount through unchanged from the orders seed
patch:
--- a/dbt_project/models/staging/stg_orders.sql
+++ b/dbt_project/models/staging/stg_orders.sql
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 select
     order_id,
     customer_id,
     cast(order_date as date) as order_date,
-    amount,
+    cast(regexp_replace(amount, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') as integer) as amount,
     status
 from {{ ref('orders') }}
